arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Fisher argued the IOIA grants immunity equal to foreign governments.
Mr. Verrilli argued the IOIA prescribes a fixed standard of absolute immunity.
Mr. Ellis discussed the text of Section 288a.
Justice Breyer questioned the consistency of statutory changes with original purpose.
